Privacy policy

This page explains which personal data is processed when you visit this website or get in touch, and what rights you have under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR / DSGVO).

Who is responsible

Khaled Sarhan Wien
Email: hello@studiosarhan.com

Visiting this website

This website is hosted on GitHub Pages, a service of GitHub, Inc. (USA). When you open a page, your browser sends technical data such as your IP address, the page requested, the date and time, and your browser type. GitHub processes this data to deliver the website and keep it secure. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in a working and secure website (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Data may be transferred to the USA; GitHub relies on safeguards recognised under the GDPR for such transfers, such as the EU–U.S. Data Privacy Framework or standard contractual clauses. More information: GitHub Privacy Statement.

This website does not use cookies, analytics or tracking tools. Fonts are loaded from this website itself, not from third-party font services.

Contact form

If you use the contact form, the details you enter (such as your name, email address and message) are sent through Formspree, a service of Formspree, Inc. (USA), and forwarded to us by email. We use these details only to answer your message. The legal basis is our legitimate interest in answering messages (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Data may be transferred to the USA on the basis of safeguards recognised under the GDPR. More information: Formspree Privacy Policy.

Email

If you write to hello@studiosarhan.com, your message and contact details are stored in our mailbox, which is provided by Zoho. We use them only to deal with your request.

How long data is kept

Messages are deleted once they have been dealt with, unless there is a reason to keep them longer, such as an ongoing conversation or a legal retention period.

Instagram

This website only links to our Instagram profile. No data is sent to Instagram (Meta Platforms) unless you click the link; after that, Instagram's own privacy policy applies.

Your rights

You have the right to access, rectification, erasure and restriction of processing of your personal data, the right to data portability, and the right to object to processing based on legitimate interests. To exercise these rights, write to hello@studiosarhan.com.

You can also lodge a complaint with the Austrian Data Protection Authority (Österreichische Datenschutzbehörde), Barichgasse 40–42, 1030 Wien, www.dsb.gv.at.
